articles.title: A Witch, a Mongol Empire, and a Secret Superpower!
articles.summary: Imagine a girl sold into slavery who plots revenge when Mongols invade her city. But her real weapon? Learning! This new anime mixes real history with cartoon fun. Even sumo wrestlers voice characters!

articles.title: Olivia Wilde's New Movie 'The Invite' Is the Talk of the Town!
articles.summary: Olivia Wilde's 'The Invite' opened on just 7 screens but made a splash, earning over $393,000! That's an average of $56,194 per theater. It's already beating some other A24 hits. Sounds like a party everyone wants to crash!

articles.title: Movie Magic in Upstate New York: Hudson Film Festival Is Back!
articles.summary: The Hudson Film Festival returns August 6-9 with 25 films, including a Sundance winner about a Filipina golf caddy and a Studio Ghibli classic. Plus, free workshops for middle schoolers! It's expanding to a new town, Catskill.
